title: Philadelphia Scavenger Hunt & Highlights Self-Guided Walking Tour

24/7 Live Support: Contact us at our official chat (Please note: No phone support available).

requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Total Flexibility: Start anytime you want—there is no fixed schedule. You can pause and resume as often as you like.

cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
The Best Way to Discover Philadelphia: Scavenger Hunt & Self-Guided Tour. Play, learn, and walk! Explore at your own pace with a 100% self-guided activity. Start anytime (24/7) with no guides or schedules. Pause for a photo at the Chinatown Friendship Arch or a moment of fun at Franklin Square and resume whenever you're ready—even the next day. This unique team-building activity is perfect for couples, families, and groups.

The "Complete City" Package - Everything you need in one app:

Interactive Game: Solve puzzles and discover 10+ major attractions, plus hidden gems revealed along the way.

Learn the history/legends of each site.

Insider Tips: Access hand-picked local restaurant and shop recommendations.

What you will visit: The Academy of Natural Sciences, Love Park, City Hall, Chinatown Friendship Arch, Franklin Square, Liberty Bell, Independence Hall, Museum of the American Revolution, Betsy Ross House, and Elfreth’s Alley Museum.
